heroHeadline: Russia Resumes Mass Strikes on Kyiv Within Hours of Truce Expiring, Killing 5 as Trump-Putin Call Yields No Breakthrough
heroSubtitle: Russia ended its reciprocal 72-hour pause on strikes against Kyiv with a mass missile-and-drone assault in the early hours of September 8, killing at least 5 and injuring around 70 nationwide — 3 killed and 25 injured in Kyiv alone — just a day after US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner wrapped an inconclusive round of shuttle diplomacy between Moscow and Kyiv. Hours later, President Trump held an hour-long 'frank' call with Vladimir Putin, who reiterated his vision for the peace process but produced no announced breakthrough. Russian drones struck Kyiv again on September 9, hitting a 24-story residential building in the Darnytskyi district and killing 1 while injuring 16 citywide, including two children. Russian military losses reached ~1,500,870 since 2022 per the Ukrainian General Staff, an increase of ~1,480 in the latest 24 hours.
